往日利润丰厚的房地产市场可能会完全崩溃，给我们的经济造成相当大的打击。至少从心理角度来看，更大的潜在伤害是，人们将不再有一个可以称之为家的物理场所。
texts.en:
Synthesization of the entire [root.GetSpeciesAdj] species has also meant a drastic shift in our housing practices; with minds resting easy in massive server farms, synthetic bodies can be stored in shelves. While this represents a cost-effective solution, some advocacy groups are raising some very real concerns.

The previously lucrative real-estate market could collapse entirely, leaving a considerable dent in our economy. Potentially more damaging, at least from a psychological perspective, is that people will no longer have a physical place to call home.
